PROBLEM review with no recorded time is not treated as slow. Personal problems get no PROBLEM items ("catalog problems"). A maintenance FAIL never makes a leech. Leech reactivation needs a row strictly after the suspension instant. Pass rate window = the 30 local days ending today. | D-070 | 2026-10-05 | Plan lifecycle (Slice 7): the first `GET /today` of a local date runs the engines, records proposed backlog-triage / auto-resume actions (`revision_item_actions`, reason BACKLOG_TRIAGE, with `run_id`, audited), re-runs, generates and freezes the plan (`daily_plans.input_hash` = hash of the run input hash + budget, plan history, practice minutes, carry-overs, triage keys). Later `GET /today` reads the frozen plan; the header (readiness, gaps, calibration, revision counts) is evaluated read-only (no run row per page view).
